core_metadata_found.title: Raw towed Sidescan Sonar Data (XTF format) from the Antarctic Larsen Ice Shelf acquired during the Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP1001 (2010)
core_metadata_found.summary: Abstract: This data set was acquired with a towed EdgeTech Sidescan Sonar during Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP1001 conducted in 2010 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Eugene Domack). These data files are of eXtended Triton Format (XTF) format and include Sidescan data that have not been processed. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Collaborative Research in IPY: Abrupt Environmental Change in the LARsen Ice Shelf System, Antarctica (LARISSA), and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): ANT07-32467.
creator: Domack
Domack, Eugene

metadata.title: Raw towed Sidescan Sonar Data (XTF format) from the Antarctic Larsen Ice Shelf acquired during the Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP1001 (2010)
metadata.summary: Abstract: This data set was acquired with a towed EdgeTech Sidescan Sonar during Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP1001 conducted in 2010 (Chief Scientist: Dr. Eugene Domack). These data files are of eXtended Triton Format (XTF) format and include Sidescan data that have not been processed. Data were acquired as part of the project(s): Collaborative Research in IPY: Abrupt Environmental Change in the LARsen Ice Shelf System, Antarctica (LARISSA), and funding was provided by NSF grant(s): ANT07-32467.
creator: Domack
license: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-Share Alike 3.0 United States [CC BY-NC-SA 3.0]
